title: Cranberry Apple Breakfast Muffins
description: These cranberry apple breakfast muffins are made with chopped Granny Smith apples, fresh cranberries, and cinnamon — perfect for chilly autumn mornings.
ingredients: 1 Granny Smith apple, cored and chopped
0.33333334326744 (12 ounce) package fresh cranberries, diced - or more to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 12-cup muffin tin or line cups with paper liners.

Whisk flour, brown sugar, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt together in a large bowl until evenly mixed. Beat eggs, oil, and vanilla extract together in a separate bowl until smooth; stir into flour mixture. Fold in apple and cranberries until incorporated. Divide batter among the prepared muffin cups.
Bake in the preheated oven until muffins are lightly browned on tops and a toothpick inserted into centers comes out clean, 18 to 22 minutes.
